description: This file contains an integration test class for the Credentials AMQP endpoint in the Eclipse Hono project. It sets up test fixtures, manages client connections, and verifies device registry behavior.

classes.name: CredentialsAmqpIT
classes.description: JUnit test class for the Credentials AMQP endpoint, extending CredentialsApiTests and managing lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: prepareDeviceRegistry
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, starts the device registry, and creates a credentials client.

methods.name: cleanupDeviceRegistry
methods.description: Cleans up device registry objects after each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the registry and closes the client connection after all tests.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Provides a CredentialsClient for a specific tenant.
